design_source_of_truth.location: frontend/src, frontend/src/index.css, frontend/src/workspace.css and frontend/public logo assets

primary_users: professionals who need a private local meeting record
users reviewing and analyzing their own recorded meetings
primary_jobs: start and understand a reliable meeting recording
prepare a recorded meeting into readable transcript and useful notes without technical setup
extract useful meeting/project notes and insights
recover from permission, audio, model or processing failures without losing work
primary_surfaces: new meeting and compact recording overlay
meeting detail with transcript, notes, speakers and on-demand tools

product_object_model.rule: Technical capability does not imply a user-facing decision or setting. Surface implementation concepts only when an explicit advanced choice or recovery action materially requires them.

power_tools: merge, split and raw transcript tools

workspace_navigation.compact_pattern: the same destinations and action hierarchy reflow into one sticky top toolbar; compact width must not introduce a second navigation model
workspace_navigation.rule: Today, Meeting and Projects share one workspace chrome. Meeting is opened from Today/search/project context but does not become a third peer destination. Advanced transcription, analysis and diagnostics remain contextual or utility routes.

golden_path.normal_path_rule: A configured user completes the golden path without choosing capture backend, source device, diarization, visual enrichment, provider, model, runtime, helper, process, port, model path or routing concepts.

surface_hierarchy.today: understand what happened, what needs attention and what to open or do next
surface_hierarchy.new_meeting: optionally add meeting context, see readiness and start recording; if managed AI is already active, show truthful cancellable preparation rather than pretending recording has started
surface_hierarchy.record: understand capture status and safely stop with minimal live UI work
surface_hierarchy.meeting: use the saved meeting as the canonical workspace with one primary Prepare notes action and secondary Transcript only recovery/power action
surface_hierarchy.prepare_notes: coordinate transcript then notes as one recoverable user task, expose the transcript as soon as it is ready, and preserve completed work across cancel, failure, reconnect and explicit resume
surface_hierarchy.notes_review: open ready notes first while keeping transcript, speakers and advanced tools directly reachable

complexity_disclosure.essential: Information and actions required to complete the user's current outcome.
complexity_disclosure.contextual: Optional outcome-level choices the user can understand without technical architecture knowledge, such as project organization. A capability is not contextual merely because it can change implementation behavior.
complexity_disclosure.advanced: Explicit expert trust, provider, model or quality overrides that normal use does not require.
complexity_disclosure.diagnostics: Internal runtime, helper, process, port, log, routing and model-path details used for troubleshooting rather than normal operation.
complexity_disclosure.recovery_exception: A technical condition may surface outside diagnostics only when the user must act on it; present the user-facing consequence and recovery action before raw technical detail.

resource_experience.recording_priority: While recording is active, ClosedRoom prioritizes capture and persistence and does not start heavy ASR, LLM or VLM work.
resource_experience.recording_start_priority: When Start meeting races with managed heavy work, one capture reservation in the canonical workload owner closes the admission boundary atomically. Already-active managed work reaches its normal safe boundary without force-kill; queued work stays bounded and resumes after Stop. The UI calls the waiting state preparation, never recording, and offers cancellation while it is waiting for the active AI phase.
resource_experience.heavy_work_admission: One canonical runtime policy and the existing bounded workload owner decide when heavy work may start; meeting preparation and recording admission never own a second heavy-work queue.
resource_experience.model_residency: Managed AI residency is phase-scoped and reclaimed after work; external runtimes remain caller-owned.
resource_experience.background_activity: Stable UI state must not require display-rate React updates or avoidable polling loops; bounded short-interval polling is allowed only for the transient capture-reservation handshake and stops when it grants, cancels or fails.

accessibility.target: macOS accessibility conventions plus WCAG 2.2 AA semantics for web-rendered content where applicable

workspace_rules: wide windows keep one stable workspace rail and bounded content column
compact windows reflow the same primary destinations and New Meeting action into one sticky top toolbar
narrow windows may collapse labels but must preserve semantic destinations, visible focus, utility access and avoid page-wide horizontal overflow

critical_journeys.name: Start, monitor and safely stop a local meeting recording without technical setup, including truthful safe-boundary preparation when managed AI is already active
Prepare transcript and notes with one durable action, reconnect safely and resume only missing work after failure
Move between Today, a Meeting and Projects with one stable hierarchy across wide, compact and narrow windows while keeping New Meeting primary and utilities secondary
Create or replace only the transcript through the secondary/expert path and recover from processing failure
Review transcript, speakers, notes and derived meeting evidence
Run additional meeting analyses with automatic defaults and optional advanced overrides
Explicitly analyze shared visual content without making visual capture part of normal recording

validation.accessibility_automation: frontend lint/typecheck plus component semantic review; dedicated accessibility runner not yet adopted
validation.visual_regression: N/A as an automated suite; bounded docs/assets views are references rather than pass/fail baselines
validation.manual_accessibility: REAL_ENVIRONMENT keyboard, focus, VoiceOver and reduced-motion checks for release-sensitive UI changes
validation.usability_evidence: targeted product review for high-risk workflow changes; no continuous usability study is currently declared
